create_efr_solver: create an EFR solver for a sequential game using a specified deviation type like blind action or informed action
run_efr_iterations: run EFR policy evaluation and update iterations to converge to a Nash equilibrium strategy
get_average_policy: get the time-averaged policy from an EFR solver that converges to an equilibrium strategy
generate_blind_action_deviations: generate blind action deviation objects for an information state given the number of legal actions
apply_swap_transformation: apply a local swap transformation matrix to a strategy array to compute a deviated strategy
